Usage: memoriahub android release [options]

Pre-check, then bump → build → publish as current → commit version.properties

Options:
  --bump <part>       patch, minor or major (without it the current version is
                      released if it is newer)
  --notes <text>      Release notes
  --server-url <url>  Default server URL baked into the app (default: the
                      logged-in server)
  --no-commit         Do not commit version.properties
  -h, --help          display help for command
